title: Lendflow Roundup | December
summary: Happy holidays from all of us at Lendflow! As we head into the final stretch of the year and look ahead to 2026, we’re grateful for all of our partners and the broader lending community for the support and inspiration this year. We're proud of the innovation of our team and excited to jump into 2026 with momentum. In this month’s newsletter, we’re sharing how Lendflow is building smarter lending infrastructure, plus a first look at Command Bar and our vision for an AI-native, agentic-first lending platform.

### [How Lendflow is Building Smarter Lending Infrastructure](https://www.lendflow.com/post/how-lendflow-is-building-smarter-lending-infrastructure)

### What We're Working On


‍


### [Command Bar: Building Intelligence Into Every Lending Workflow](https://www.lendflow.com/post/command-bar-building-intelligence-into-every-lending-workflow)


We’re excited to announce the launch of Command Bar, Lendflow’s AI-native, agentic-first interface that starts with Semantic Search (Command-K) and support agents today. As this functionality grows it will become a unified gateway where teams can trigger end-to-end lending tasks with natural language.


[See How it Works >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/command-bar-building-intelligence-into-every-lending-workflow)
